notes.title: Annie: Last Hope – Re-release & Update Notes
notes.content: [p]Following a round of optimization and adjustments, [i]Annie: Last Hope[/i] will soon be available for purchase again. The latest update includes the following improvements:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Added Japanese language support[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New aiming guide feature[/b], which can be enabled in the game settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance optimizations[/b], including reduced memory usage and improved frame rates[/p][/*][/olist][p]We sincerely thank all players who have supported [i]Annie: Last Hope[/i]. We will continue to update and improve the game to bring you an even better gameplay experience.[/p]

notes.title: ANNIE: Last Hope Temporary Suspension of Sales Notice
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We would like to inform you that ANNIE: Last Hope will temporarily suspend sales starting from April 2025 and is expected to return in Q4 2025 with an updated version.

We sincerely appreciate your support and understanding. Please rest assured that existing players can still enjoy the game as usual, and the game’s content and features will not be affected.

Thank you for your continued support of ANNIE: Last Hope. We look forward to meeting you again in the near future.

Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Annie: Last Hope OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
After 4-mouths Early Access, Annie: Last Hope is out on Steam! Big thanks to the gamer’s comment and review, which are precious treasures for our development. 

A 10% discount is offered at launch for a week. One week later, the price will increase slightly.

ANNIE: Last Hope is an HD-Voxel top-down shooting game. It's bringing a brand new adventure to players by exciting battle experience, amazing bosses, and challenging level design.

[b]Top-down Shooting! [/b]
Pick up your gun and shoot to the zombie, enjoy the challenging and exciting battle in Annie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36090765/f6127e07b8b18c0b12a21a7f2d3d8a1f2ca44dee.jpg[/img]

[b]Unique Word [/b]
Build by HD-Voxel, and most models can be broken into small cubes. In Annie, have fun with destruction, you will love it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36090765/001fb59824ea4a26ae41776a897c7c09e4e58ad1.jpg[/img]

[b]Call up all your friends, let us explore Annie, a fantastic HD-Voxel world together! [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1174390/ANNIELast_Hope/
